verification: Official PyPI JSON and downloaded wheel METADATA; wheel SHA-256 verified before source inspection. Model probes used synthetic local MockTransport only.
private_seams_requiring_upgrade_tests: ChatAnthropic._stream and _astream both pass raw SDK events through _make_message_chunk_from_anthropic_event; message_stop is otherwise discarded.
ChatAnthropic._create and _acreate return SDK raw-response objects with the native http_response, retained only for explicit close/aclose on iterator exit. No parser or mapper replacement.

The per-iterator ContextVar is set/reset only around each native next/anext and close/aclose, and is reset before yielding a chunk to the caller. Same-thread and same-task interleaved iterators must not share terminal evidence.
limits: Top-level system projection is supported; the adapter rejects non-consecutive SystemMessages even on models whose HTTP API supports inline system.
stream_usage and chunk_position=last do not prove receipt of message_stop.
No public client/root_client/http_client injection field exists in this adapter version; tests patch only the native HTTP-client factory.
Terminal-event validation is not semantic validation, tool success, checkpoint publication, or a natural-model quality result.
